DS065 is a medical diagnosis code used in the Danish healthcare system to classify traumatic subdural hemorrhage. Within the context of the national clinical quality databases managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code plays a critical role in monitoring patient safety, specifically for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]]. 

Because patients with atrial fibrillation are frequently prescribed anticoagulant medications, they carry an elevated risk of severe bleeding events. To track these adverse outcomes, DS065 is utilized as one of the specific diagnostic markers for [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] [^src1] [^src3]. In the annual registry reports, DS065 is grouped alongside related neurological codes such as [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], and [[ds066|DS066]] to calculate the incidence of intracranial bleeding among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. 

Furthermore, DS065 is incorporated into a broader composite indicator measuring the incidence of any severe bleeding. This wider metric encompasses not only intracranial hemorrhages but also gastrointestinal bleeding (e.g., [[dk25-0|DK25.0]]–[[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. By standardizing these diagnostic codes, the RKKP enables consistent data collection and cross-regional comparison of anticoagulation safety across Denmark [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].
